question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.**
solution: The correct answer is: **Control** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Control **means the power to manage or direct something. (किसी चीज़ को प्रबंधित या निर्देशित करने की शक्ति) • **For example- ***She struggled to maintain control of the car in the rain.* • In the given sentence, "**control**" is the appropriate word choice because it accurately captures the idea of the artisan's mastery and skill over their tools or implements. • The word "control" implies not only the ability to use the tools effectively but also the finesse and precision with which they are wielded. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**. Complete paragraph: *I went on (1) steadily__ trying to 'find out how to'; but I wrote two or three novels without feeling that I had made __(2) much__ progress. It was not until I wrote 'Ethan Frome' that I suddenly felt the artisan's full __(3) **control **__of his implements. When 'Ethan Frome' first appeared, I was (4) ______ criticised by the reviewers for what was considered the clumsy structure of the tale. I had pondered long on this structure, had felt its peculiar difficulties, and possible awkwardness, but could think of no (5) ______ which would serve as well in the given case: and though I am far from thinking 'Ethan Frome' is my best novel, and am bored and even exasperated when I am told that it is, I am still sure that its structure is not its weak point.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Dissent **means disagreement or opposition. (असहमति या विरोध) • **Stability **means the state of being steady or unchanging. (स्थिर या अपरिवर्तनीय होने की अवस्था या भाव) • **Rigidity **means stiffness or inflexibility. (कठोरता या अनम्यता) 45:T1178, The correct answer is: **severely**
